Maya (Sales): ACME requests a short demo change: reduce Dedicated POC pool ded-poc-acme-55 min_capacity 22->7 and shorten burst window 120m->20m for demo tomorrow. Also want ephemeral API key restricted to their office IPs TTL=48h. Need feasibility + cost exposure by EOD.

Ken (Infra): We can apply an ephemeral quota overlay and attach ephemeral burst credits. Note: reservation commit unchanged; any overage billed as overage. 24h required to change commit. Recommend cooldown=12m to avoid thrash and set fallback to hosted-light.

Roh (Eng): Suggested overlay patch:
{"min_capacity":"7","burst_window":"20m","cooldown":"12m","ephemeral_credits":"80","fallback":"hosted-light"}
Add alert: sustained >80% for 4m -> page on-call.

ops-bot: [automated] Ticket POC-8210 created. Status: awaiting-sales-approval.

Maya (Sales): Sales approves ephemeral overlay and billing exposure for demo only. Sylvia, confirm TTL=48h and IP allowlist.

sylvia-acme (ACME): Confirmed. Proceed. Thanks!

Ken (Infra): Scheduling change T-2h before demo. I will create key name acme-poc-55-ephemeral TTL=48h scoped to provided IPs and apply overlay. Will post runbook when scheduled.

ops-bot: [automated] POC-8210 scheduled. Change window: 2026-10-01T13:00Z->2026-10-01T14:30Z.

Maya (Sales): Thanks team :thumbsup:
